source.title: Lieutenant Governors of British Columbia, 1871-Present
source.revision: Updated January 2025 (cover, PDF p.1); PDF metadata CreationDate/ModDate 2025-02-19
source.locator_convention: 'PDF page n' = physical page in the file (1-19); printed folio = PDF page minus 1. Summary table on PDF pp.3-6; per-person date citations on PDF pp.7-18; suggested readings p.19.

field_definitions_pdf_p2.commissioned: date of the first Privy Council order approving/referring to the appointment
field_definitions_pdf_p2.effective: date the commission (BC Gazette or P.C. order) specified; some commissions said only that the appointment takes effect when sworn in
field_definitions_pdf_p2.sworn_in: date the oath of office was taken
field_definitions_pdf_p2.end: predecessor's term ends on the earlier of the successor's appointment-effective date or swearing-in date

source.interval_convention: PDF end dates are the successor's start date (shared boundary day); treat as half-open [start, end) when rendering.

comparison_source.upstream: Wikipedia 'List of lieutenant governors of British Columbia' rev 1355442226 (2026-05-21); wikitext saved at tmp/research/atlas/raw/wiki_lg_bc.html

summary.count_difference_explained_by: one unnumbered administrator row (James Alexander MacDonald, 1920-12-12 to 1920-12-24) carried over from Wikipedia; no duplicates
summary.local_dates_pattern: Local from/to values mix conventions: for most pre-1936 holders and several later ones the local start is the Privy Council commission date (and the predecessor's end is set to it), whereas for others it is the swearing-in or effective date. Three local dates (Trutch start 1871-07-05, Cornwall start/Richards end 1881-06-21, Campagnolo end/Point start 2007-09-30) match no date in the PDF.

gaps: No primary source (BC Gazette, Order in Council, newspaper) found for James Alexander MacDonald as Administrator 1920-12-12 to 1920-12-24; only Wikipedia's uncited table row.

The PDF lists no administrators; a complete list of Administrators of the Government of BC (acting during absences, deaths, vacancies) was not located. Only DCB's mention of Macdonald in Oct 1915 and Jan-Feb 1917 (month precision) was found.
Origin of Wikipedia/local dates that match no PDF date (1871-07-05, 1881-06-21, 2007-09-30) not traced.

PDF internal conflicts not resolved against primary sources: Bruce commission 1926-01-21 (table) vs P.C. 1926-100 dated January 26, 1926 (citations); P.C. 2007-1317 dated August 31, 2007 (Point) vs October 1, 2007 (Campagnolo citation); Banks end 1950-10-02 vs PDF rule giving 1950-10-01.
Birth dates unknown in PDF for Austin and Cocchia; Guichon birth year only; Point's and Guichon's death not recorded (living at PDF date).
Current officeholder status after January 2025 not verified beyond the LG website statement that Cocchia was sworn in as 31st LG in 2025 (fetched 2026-09-25).
